**Limited availability.** The workflow API is currently enabled for selected sub-accounts only; any other sub-account receives 403 `WORKFLOW_API_NOT_ENABLED_FOR_LOCATION`.

Count the log records of one workflow, grouped by one or more dimensions. It answers how many: enrollments, completions, failures per step, why contacts left, and trends over time. To answer who, use Get Workflow Logs.

**Before you call it.** Get `workflowId` from Search Workflows. Never pass a workflow name.

**Grouping.** Each row holds one value for every dimension in `groupBy`, plus `count`. Grouping by `week`, `day` or `hour` adds `bucket`, the start of each interval in `timezone`. `startDate` and `endDate` always stay UTC. Rows are sorted by the grouped values in ascending order (`status`, then `type`, `stepId`, `removedReason` and `bucket`), not by count.

**Finding filter values.** Group by a dimension to see which values this workflow has, then filter on them. For example, `groupBy=removedReason` lists the reasons present, and those values work in `removedReasons`.

**Steps.** Rows grouped by `stepId` also carry `stepName`, the name of that step on its most recent log record in the date range. `stepId` matches `actions[].id` in Get Workflow Definition. A step count includes the `remove_from_workflow` record written when a contact leaves the workflow at that step, so group by `stepId` and `type` together to count how often the step itself ran.

**Common questions.**
- Enrollments: `statuses=added_to_workflow`
- Completions: `removedReasons=end_of_workflow`. Divide by enrollments for a completion rate
- Failures per step: `statuses=error,failed,failed_retry_limit_reached&groupBy=stepId`
- Why contacts left: `types=remove_from_workflow&groupBy=removedReason`
- Stopped because the contact replied: `removedReasons=contact_reply_stop_response`
- Goal reached: `types=workflow_goal&statuses=success`
- Enrollment trend: `statuses=added_to_workflow&groupBy=week` (or `day`)
- Change over time: call twice with back-to-back windows of equal length and compare

Completions in a window can include contacts who enrolled before it, so a completion rate can exceed 100%. With fewer than about 30 enrollments, rates swing widely. Zero is a real answer. A `workflowId` that does not exist in the sub-account returns 404.

**Limits.** The range defaults to the last 30 days and must not exceed 30 days. Logs are available for the last 60 days. A grouping that produces more rows than `limit` is refused with 422 rather than truncated, because a truncated count reports wrong totals.

**Compatibility.** New optional fields and new values of `status`, `type` and `removedReason` can appear at any time. Ignore fields you do not know, and treat an unknown value as other.

List the step-by-step execution history of one workflow, newest first. Each record is one step of one run for one contact or record, with its outcome and timing. It answers who and what: who entered, what happened to a contact, which steps failed and for whom. To answer how many, use Get Workflow Log Statistics.

**Before you call it.** Get `workflowId` from Search Workflows. Never pass a workflow name. To see what each step is, call Get Workflow Definition: its `actions[].id` matches `stepId` here.

**Step details.** `meta` says how the contact entered, why a step was skipped or failed, what a step did, whether a wait timed out, and why the contact left. A key is left out when it does not apply. Only the keys documented under `meta` are returned. New keys may be added later (see Compatibility).

**Paging.** The response holds `logs`, their `count`, and `nextCursor`. The first call (`action=first`, the default) returns the newest page. For the next (older) page, send `action=next` with `referenceId` and `referenceCreatedAt` from `nextCursor`, unchanged, and keep the same filters and dates. `nextCursor` is null when there are no more records. - Who entered the workflow: `statuses=added_to_workflow`
- Which steps failed, and for whom: `statuses=error,failed,failed_retry_limit_reached`
- What happened to one contact: `contactId=`
- Every step of one run: `executionId=`

field.description:
Field to filter on (filter item). The supported fields, grouped as in the Contacts Search API reference, with the operators each one supports:

### Contact Information

| Display name | Field name | Supported operators | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Contact Id | `id` | `eq`, `not_eq` | `{ "field": "id", "operator": "eq", "value": "{contactId}" }` |
| Contact Name | `contactName` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "contactName", "operator": "eq", "value": "John Doe" }` |
| Address | `address` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "address", "operator": "contains", "value": "Main Street" }` |
| Assigned | `assignedTo` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "assignedTo", "operator": "eq", "value": "{userId}" }` |
| Business Name | `businessName` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "businessName", "operator": "contains", "value": "acme" }` |
| City | `city` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "city", "operator": "eq", "value": "New York" }` |
| Country | `country` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "country", "operator": "eq", "value": "US" }` |
| Company Name | `companyName` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "companyName", "operator": "eq", "value": "XYZ Corp" }` |
| Created At | `dateAdded` | `range`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "dateAdded", "operator": "range", "value": { "gte": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", "lte": "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z" } }` |
| Updated At | `dateUpdated` | `range`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "dateUpdated", "operator": "range", "value": { "gte": "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z" } }` |
| DND | `dnd` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "dnd", "operator": "eq", "value": true }` |
| Email | `email` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `exists`, `not_exists` `contains` and `not_contains` are not yet supported | `{ "field": "email", "operator": "eq", "value": "john@example.com" }` |
| Followers | `followers` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "followers", "operator": "eq", "value": "{userId}" }` |
| First Name Lower Case | `firstNameLowerCase` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "firstNameLowerCase", "operator": "eq", "value": "john" }` |
| First Name (Without Lower Case) | Coming soon! | Coming soon! | Coming soon! |
| Last Name Lower Case | `lastNameLowerCase` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "lastNameLowerCase", "operator": "contains", "value": "doe" }` |
| Last Name (Without Lower Case) | Coming soon! | Coming soon! | Coming soon! |
| Is Valid Whatsapp | `isValidWhatsapp` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "isValidWhatsapp", "operator": "eq", "value": true }` |
| Last Email Clicked Date | `lastEmailClickedDate` | `range`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "lastEmailClickedDate", "operator": "range", "value": { "gte": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", "lte": "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z" } }` |
| Last Email Opened Date | `lastEmailOpenedDate` | `range`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "lastEmailOpenedDate", "operator": "exists" }` |
| Phone Pass the correct country code, e.g. `+917010000000` | `phone` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "phone", "operator": "eq", "value": "+917010000000" }` |
| Postal Zip Code | `postalCode` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "postalCode", "operator": "eq", "value": "10001" }` |
| Source | `source` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "source", "operator": "eq", "value": "Website" }` |
| State | `state` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "state", "operator": "eq", "value": "California" }` |
| Tags | `tags` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "tags", "operator": "eq", "value": "vip" }` |
| Timezone e.g. `Pacific/Honolulu` | `timezone` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "timezone", "operator": "eq", "value": "Pacific/Honolulu" }` |
| Contact Type | `type` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "type", "operator": "eq", "value": "lead" }` |
| Is Valid Email Applies only if Email Validation is enabled for the location | `validEmail` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "validEmail", "operator": "eq", "value": true }` |
| Website | `website` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `exists`, `not_exists` `contains` and `not_contains` are not yet supported | `{ "field": "website", "operator": "exists" }` |
| Date of Birth | `dateOfBirth` | `range`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "dateOfBirth", "operator": "range", "value": { "gte": "1990-01-01", "lte": "1990-12-31" } }` |

### Contact Activity

| Display name | Field name | Supported operators | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Last Appointment - Confirmed/Open | `lastAppointment` | `range`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "lastAppointment", "operator": "range", "value": { "gte": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", "lte": "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z" } }` |
| Workflow (Active) | `activeWorkflows` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "activeWorkflows", "operator": "eq", "value": "{workflowId}" }` |
| Workflow (Finished) | `finishedWorkflows` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "finishedWorkflows", "operator": "eq", "value": "{workflowId}" }` |
| Last Activity | `lastActivity` | `range`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "lastActivity", "operator": "range", "value": { "gte": "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z" } }` |

### Opportunity Information

| Display name | Field name | Supported operators | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pipeline | field `opportunities` sub field `pipelineId` | field: `nested` sub field: `eq`, `not_eq`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "opportunities", "operator": "nested", "value": [ { "field": "pipelineId", "operator": "eq", "value": "{pipelineId}" } ] }` |
| Pipeline Stage | field `opportunities` sub field `pipelineStageId` | field: `nested` sub field: `eq`, `not_eq`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "opportunities", "operator": "nested", "value": [ { "field": "pipelineStageId", "operator": "eq", "value": "{pipelineStageId}" } ] }` |
| Pipeline Status | field `opportunities` sub field `status` | field: `nested` sub field: `eq`, `not_eq`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "opportunities", "operator": "nested", "value": [ { "field": "status", "operator": "eq", "value": "open" } ] }` |

Example: opportunities combination filter, open opportunities in one pipeline stage

```json
{
  "field": "opportunities",
  "operator": "nested",
  "value": [
    {
      "field": "pipelineId",
      "operator": "eq",
      "value": "{pipelineId}"
    },
    {
      "field": "pipelineStageId",
      "operator": "eq",
      "value": "{pipelineStageId}"
    },
    {
      "field": "status",
      "operator": "eq",
      "value": "open"
    }
  ]
}
```

You can combine 2 or more sub-fields under the `opportunities` nested filter.

### Custom Fields

| Display name | Field name | Supported operators | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TEXT, LARGE_TEXT, SINGLE_OPTIONS, RADIO, PHONE | `customFields.{customFieldId}` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "customFields.{customFieldId}", "operator": "contains", "value": "gold" }` |
| CHECKBOX, MULTIPLE_OPTIONS | `customFields.{customFieldId}` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "customFields.{customFieldId}", "operator": "eq", "value": [ "Newsletter", "Promotions" ] }` |
| NUMERICAL, MONETORY | `customFields.{customFieldId}` | `range`, `exists`, `not_exists`, `eq`, `not_eq` | `{ "field": "customFields.{customFieldId}", "operator": "range", "value": { "gte": 100, "lte": 500 } }` |
| DATE | `customFields.{customFieldId}` | `range`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "customFields.{customFieldId}", "operator": "range", "value": { "gte": "2026-01-01", "lte": "2026-12-31" } }` |
| TEXTBOX_LIST | `customFields.{customFieldId}.{optionId}` | `eq`, `not_eq`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `exists`, `not_exists` | `{ "field": "customFields.{customFieldId}.{optionId}", "operator": "eq", "value": "Line one" }` |

- Custom field: `customFields.{customFieldId}`, e.g. `customFields.OBj007JIEmLP0IEHdV1l`.
- TEXTBOX_LIST: add the option id, `customFields.{customFieldId}.{optionId}`, e.g. `customFields.OBj007JIEmLP0IEHdV1l.c1b70ec9-664f-400f-a3fc-6f7912c5e310`.
- CHECKBOX / MULTIPLE_OPTIONS: `value` is an option, or an array of options to match any of them.

operator.description:
Operator to apply (filter item). Each field supports only some operators; see the supported operators of each field.

#### `eq`: Equals

- **Value type:** Number, String, Boolean
- **Character limit:** 75

Example

```json
{
  "field": "tags",
  "operator": "eq",
  "value": "vip"
}
```

#### `not_eq`: Not Equals

- **Value type:** Number, String, Boolean
- **Character limit:** 75

Example

```json
{
  "field": "type",
  "operator": "not_eq",
  "value": "lead"
}
```

#### `contains`: Contains

- **Value type:** String, at least 3 characters
- **Character limit:** 75
- ⚠️ The `contains` operator does not support special characters.

Example

```json
{
  "field": "firstNameLowerCase",
  "operator": "contains",
  "value": "john"
}
```

#### `not_contains`: Not Contains

- **Value type:** String, at least 3 characters
- **Character limit:** 75
- ⚠️ The `not_contains` operator does not support special characters.

Example

```json
{
  "field": "city",
  "operator": "not_contains",
  "value": "york"
}
```

#### `exists`: Exists (has a value)

- **Value type:** Undefined
- **Character limit:** None
- ⚠️ **Do not pass any `value`**; `field` and `operator` are enough.

Example

```json
{
  "field": "email",
  "operator": "exists"
}
```

#### `not_exists`: Does not exist (no value)

- **Value type:** Undefined
- **Character limit:** None
- ⚠️ **Do not pass any `value`**; `field` and `operator` are enough.

Example

```json
{
  "field": "phone",
  "operator": "not_exists"
}
```

#### `range`: Range

- **Value type:** An object with `gte` / `lte` (or `gt` / `lt`) bounds: dates for date fields, numbers for number fields
- **Character limit:** 75

Example

```json
{
  "field": "dateAdded",
  "operator": "range",
  "value": {
    "gte": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "lte": "2026-06-30T23:59:59Z"
  }
}
```

#### `nested`: Opportunity filters

- **Value type:** An array of filters on the `opportunities` sub-fields (`pipelineId`, `pipelineStageId`, `status`); all must match
- **Character limit:** As for each sub-filter

Example

```json
{
  "field": "opportunities",
  "operator": "nested",
  "value": [
    {
      "field": "pipelineId",
      "operator": "eq",
      "value": "{pipelineId}"
    },
    {
      "field": "status",
      "operator": "eq",
      "value": "open"
    }
  ]
}
```

accountIds.description:
Account IDs for the post. Each account ID identifies a connected social media account.

**Get IDs from:** [Get Accounts API](/social-media-posting/oauth/{locationId}/accounts) — use the `id` field from each account.

**One request = one post, shared across every account in this list.**
- All accounts share the same `summary` and the same `media` array.
- `summary` is trimmed to the **strictest** character limit among the selected platforms. Adding a Bluesky account (300 chars) therefore trims the caption to 300 for Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn in that same request.
- `media` is capped to each platform's own maximum at publish time (e.g. Bluesky publishes the first 4 items, Instagram the first 20).
- **To keep full-length, platform-specific captions, send one request per platform** - one post per platform, each with only that platform's account IDs.

**Validations:**
- Required for non-draft posts
- Must be a non-empty array
- All account IDs must be valid connected accounts for the location

summary.description:
Post content/caption text. Character limits vary by platform.

**Custom Values & Hashtags:**
- You can include custom values/variables in the content (e.g., `{{contact.name}}`)
- Hashtags: Use `#hashtag` format. Instagram allows max 30 hashtags.
- Mentions: Use platform-specific mention format (see `mentions` field for structured mentions)

**Validations:**
- Instagram/Facebook Story: Caption NOT supported for direct publishing
- Facebook, LinkedIn, GMB: Content OR media is required (at least one)

**Trimming across multiple platforms:**
One post carries ONE caption for every account in `accountIds`, so the caption is silently trimmed to the **strictest** limit among the selected platforms — not to each platform's own limit.
- Facebook 63,206 · LinkedIn 3,000 · Instagram / TikTok 2,200 · Google 1,500 · Pinterest 800 · Threads 500 · **Bluesky 300**
- Example: `accountIds` covering Facebook + Instagram + Bluesky trims the caption to **300 characters on all three**.
- Instagram/Facebook Stories without push-notification publishing force the limit to 0, dropping the caption entirely.
- **To keep the full caption on each platform, send one request per platform** instead of one request mixing platforms.

**Reference:** Platform Limitations Guide
summary.example: Hello World! Check out our latest updates. #social #marketing

media.description:
Post Media Data. Per-platform media limits are listed in the reference link in the API description.

**Across multiple platforms:** the same media array is sent to every account in `accountIds` and capped to each platform's own maximum at publish time — the array is NOT reduced to the strictest limit the way `summary` is. An 8-item array publishes 8 items to Facebook and the first 4 to Bluesky.
Send one request per platform if a platform needs a different set of media.

url.description: Public URL of the media file. Must be a valid, accessible HTTPS URL.

caption.description: Alt text or caption for the media. Used for accessibility and SEO.

originalUrl.description: Original media URL before any processing (watermarking/optimization). Set automatically by the system.

watermarkedUrl.description: URL of the media after watermarking. Set automatically when watermark is applied.

type.description: MIME type of the media file. See Platform Limitations Guide for platform-specific format support.

thumbnail.description:
Cover image URL for a video media item.

**Scope**
- Applies to the **first video** in `media[]`. Values supplied on subsequent video items are ignored.
- Has no effect on image-only media items.

**Response behavior**
- After the post is published, the resolved cover image is surfaced on the post-level `thumbnail` field of the response and is no longer echoed back inside `media[]`. This represents the post's primary cover image and the cover used for the first video.

**Limitations**
- Per-item thumbnails for multi-video posts are not supported. Each destination network exposes a single cover image per post for the leading video; this matches the behavior of the underlying social platform APIs.

**Format**
- Provide a publicly accessible JPEG or PNG URL. Animated formats and video URLs are not accepted.
- Recommended: an image matching the orientation of your video and ≤ 2 MB.

defaultThumb.description: Default thumbnail URL, auto-generated from video if not provided.

id.description: Unique identifier for the media item. Used for tracking and referencing.

optimizedUrl.description:
URL of the optimized/compressed media. Set automatically when media optimization is enabled.

**Enable Optimization:** Set `mediaOptimization: true` in the post request.

optimizedType.description: MIME type of the optimized media. May differ from original if format conversion occurred.

isModified.description: Flag indicating if the media was modified (watermarked, optimized, or processed).

altText.description: Alt text for accessibility. Supported on Instagram, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, and LinkedIn image posts (ignored for video and other platforms). Auto-truncated per platform: Pinterest 500, Instagram/Threads 1000, Bluesky 2000, LinkedIn 4086 chars.
altText.example: A sunset over the ocean with silhouetted palm trees

status.description:
Post status indicating the current state of the post.

**Available Status Values:**
- `draft` - Post saved as draft, not yet ready for publishing
- `scheduled` - Post scheduled for future publishing (requires `scheduleDate`)
- `in_review` - Post pending approval (requires `scheduleDate` and `postApprovalDetails`)
- `published` - Post has been published
- `in_progress` - Post is currently being processed
- `pending` - Post is awaiting platform processing for Instagram media container creation
- `failed` - Post publishing failed
- `notification_sent` - Story notification sent (for manual story posting)
- `deleted` - Post has been deleted

**Validations:**
- `scheduled` or `in_review` status requires `scheduleDate` to be set
- Submitting for review (`in_review`) requires `postApprovalDetails.approver`; approve/reject actions reuse the stored approver
- Draft posts skip most validations (accountIds, media requirements)

scheduleDate.description: Schedule Date. Required when `status` is `scheduled` or `in_review`.

selectedBestTime.description: Selected Best Time slot for scheduling

createdBy.description:
User ID of the creator who is creating/managing the post. Must be a valid 24-character hex ID.

**Get User IDs from:** [Get User API](/users/{userId}) — use the `id` field from the user object.

**Validation:** Must be a valid 24-character hex ID.

followUpComment.description:
Follow-up comment to be posted immediately after the main post is published.

**Supported Platforms:** Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Community, Threads, Bluesky, YouTube, TikTok

**NOT Supported:** GBP (Google Business Profile), Pinterest

- TikTok: posted once the video becomes publicly viewable (~1-3 min), not instantly

- TikTok: only public videos support a follow-up comment. Set `privacyLevel` to `PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE` — friends-only and private videos are not supported

**Use Case:** Great for adding hashtags, additional context, or engagement prompts without cluttering the main post.

- Like `summary`, the follow-up comment is trimmed to the **strictest** limit among the post's platforms, not to each platform's own limit — a post that includes Bluesky (300) trims the comment to 300 everywhere. Send one request per platform to keep the full comment on each.

**Reference:** Platform Limitations Guide
followUpComment.example: What do you think? Let us know in the comments!

metaImage.description:
Preview image URL for the shared link.

**Best Practices:**
- Use high-quality images (1200x630px recommended)
- Ensure the image is publicly accessible

**Auto-fetch:** Use the Get Metatags API to fetch OG data from a URL.

metaLink.description: URL of the webpage being shared. This is the destination when users click the link preview.

ogTitle.description:
Custom title for the link preview. Overrides the page's og:title meta tag.

**Tip:** Keep titles concise (50-60 characters) for best display across platforms.
ogTitle.example: How to Double Your Social Media Engagement

ogDescription.description:
Custom description for the link preview. Overrides the page's og:description meta tag.

**Tip:** Keep descriptions under 155 characters for optimal display.
ogDescription.example: Learn proven strategies to boost your social media engagement and grow your audience.

type.description:
Type of post to create. Determines the format and platform requirements.

**Available Types:**
- `post` - Standard feed post (all platforms)
- `story` - Temporary 24-hour story (Instagram, Facebook)
- `reel` - Short-form video content (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube)

**Customize Per Platform:**
You can specify different content/types per platform using `facebookPostDetails.type`, `instagramPostDetails.type`, etc.

**Validations:**
- Reels require exactly 1 video
- Stories: Caption not supported for Instagram/Facebook
- Facebook Groups do not support Reels

approver.description:
User ID of the designated approver.

**Note:** The approver will receive a notification when a post is submitted for review.

requesterNote.description: Note from the post creator to the approver explaining the post or requesting specific feedback.
requesterNote.example: Please review the messaging for our Q4 campaign launch. Let me know if the CTA needs adjustment.

approverNote.description: Note from the approver to the post creator with feedback or approval comments.
approverNote.example: Approved! Great content. Consider adding more hashtags for visibility.

approvalStatus.description:
Current approval status of the post.

**Available Values:**
- `pending` - Awaiting approver review
- `approved` - Approved and ready for publishing
- `rejected` - Rejected by approver (needs revision)
- `not_required` - No approval workflow needed

scheduleTimeUpdated.description: Flag indicating if the schedule datetime was manually updated. Used for tracking rescheduled posts.

tags.description:
Array of Tag IDs to associate with the post for organization and filtering.

**Get Tag IDs from:** [Get Tags API](/social-media-posting/{locationId}/tags) — use the `_id` field from each tag.

**Validation:** All IDs must be valid 24-character hex IDs.

categoryId.description:
Category ID to organize the post. Categories help group related posts.

**Get Category IDs from:** [Get Categories API](/social-media-posting/{locationId}/categories) — use the `_id` field.

**Validation:** Must be a valid 24-character hex ID.

applyWatermark.description:
Apply watermark to media in this post.

**Note:** Watermarks are applied to images only. Videos are not watermarked.

privacyLevel.description:
Privacy level controlling who can view the video.

**Available Values:**
- `PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE` - Anyone can view (default)
- `MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS` - Only mutual followers can view
- `SELF_ONLY` - Only you can view (private)

**Note:** If set to `SELF_ONLY`, `videoDisclosure` must be `false`.

promoteOtherBrand.description:
Indicates if the video promotes a third-party brand or product.

**Required:** Must be `true` if `videoDisclosure` is enabled and you're promoting another brand.

enableComment.description: Allow users to comment on the video. Default is determined by account settings.

enableDuet.description:
Allow users to create Duet videos with your content.

**Duet:** Side-by-side video featuring your content and the creator's reaction/addition.

enableStitch.description:
Allow users to create Stitch videos with your content.

**Stitch:** Clips up to 5 seconds of your video that creators can use in their own videos.

videoDisclosure.description:
Enable branded content disclosure. Required when video is promotional content.

**Validations:**
- Cannot be `true` if `privacyLevel` is `SELF_ONLY`
- If enabled, at least one of `promoteYourBrand` or `promoteOtherBrand` must be `true`

promoteYourBrand.description:
Indicates if the video promotes your own brand or product.

**Required:** Must be `true` if `videoDisclosure` is enabled and you're promoting your own brand.

gmbEventType.description:
Google My Business post type.

**Available Types:**
- `STANDARD` - Regular update post (What's New)
- `EVENT` - Event announcement with dates and title
- `OFFER` - Promotional offer with coupon and redemption details

**Required fields by type:**
- STANDARD: None additional
- EVENT: `title`, `startDate`, `endDate`
- OFFER: `offerTitle`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `termsConditions`, `couponCode`, `redeemOnlineUrl`

title.description:
Event title. Required when `gmbEventType` is `EVENT`.

**Max length:** 58 characters

termsConditions.description: URL to terms and conditions page. Required for OFFER posts.

url.description:
Call-to-action URL. Required when `actionType` is set (except `none` and `call`).

**Required for:** STANDARD and EVENT posts with actionType other than `none` or `call`.

couponCode.description: Promotional coupon code. Required for OFFER posts.

redeemOnlineUrl.description: URL where customers can redeem the offer online. Required for OFFER posts.

actionType.description:
Call-to-action button type for the post.

**Available Actions:**
- `none` - No action button
- `order` - Order online
- `book` - Book appointment
- `shop` - Shop now
- `learn_more` - Learn more
- `call` - Call now (no URL required)
- `sign_up` - Sign up

**Note:** All actions except `none` and `call` require a `url`.

userId.description: User ID of the user creating/managing the post. Required for OAuth channel posts (non-draft).

linkedinPostDetails.description:
LinkedIn-specific post configuration.

**Key Fields:**
- `postAsPdf`: Set to `true` to post images as a PDF carousel document
- `pdfTitle`: Title for the PDF document (max 100 characters)

**Limits:**
- Max 20 images, or 1 video, for regular posts
- Max 300 pages for PDF carousel
- Max PDF size: 100 MB

**Reference:** Platform Limitations Guide

pdfTitle.description:
Title for the PDF document carousel. Displayed as the document name on LinkedIn.

**Max length:** 100 characters

**Tip:** Use a descriptive title that explains the document content.

postAsPdf.description:
Post images as a PDF document carousel.

**Limits:**
- Max 300 pages/images
- Max PDF size: 100 MB

poll.description:
Publish a LinkedIn poll post.

**Required fields when `poll` is supplied:**
- `question` (max 140 characters)
- `options`: 2 to 4 entries, each `text` ≤ 30 characters; option texts must be unique
- `settings.duration`: one of `ONE_DAY`, `THREE_DAYS`, `SEVEN_DAYS`, `FOURTEEN_DAYS`

**LinkedIn restrictions:**
- Polls cannot be edited after publishing.
- A poll post cannot include `media` or a meta-link preview.

question.description: Question for the poll. Max length: 140 characters.

options.description: Poll options. Minimum 2, maximum 4. Each option text max 30 characters. Option texts must be unique.

text.description: Text describing the option. Max length: 30 characters.

duration.description: Duration the poll stays open for votes.

pinterestPostDetails.description:
Pinterest-specific post configuration. Required when posting to Pinterest accounts.

**Required Fields:**
- `boardIds`: Object mapping account OAuth IDs to Pinterest board IDs

**Optional Fields:**
- `title`: Pin title (max 100 characters)
- `link`: Destination URL for the pin (max 2048 characters)

**Get Board IDs:** Use the Pinterest boards API or retrieve from connected account details.

**Limits:**
- Max 1 image/video per pin
- Caption max 800 characters

**Reference:** Platform Limitations Guide

title.description:
Pin title displayed on Pinterest.

**Max length:** 100 characters

**Best Practices:**
- Include relevant keywords
- Be descriptive and engaging

link.description:
Destination URL for the pin. Users clicking the pin will be directed to this URL.

**Max length:** 2048 characters

**Best Practices:**
- Use direct links to relevant content
- Track with UTM parameters for analytics

boardIds.description:
**DEPRECATED — use `pinterestBoards` instead.** Will be removed on July 31, 2026.

Legacy mapping of Pinterest account OAuth IDs to a single board ID:
`{ accountOAuthId: "boardId" }`

For multi-board posting, use `pinterestBoards`.

pinterestBoards.description:
Per-account Pinterest board selection. Each entry binds one connected Pinterest account to a list of boards on that account. Each board produces an independent child post tracked separately for success/failure. Capped at 25 boards per account.

When supplied, this field takes precedence over the deprecated `boardIds` field.

boards.description: Pinterest board IDs to publish to on this account. Each board produces an independent child post tracked separately for success/failure. Capped at 25 boards per account.

facebookPostDetails.description:
Facebook-specific post configuration.

**Key Fields:**
- `type`: Post type (`post`, `story`, `reel`)

**Restrictions:**
- Facebook Groups do NOT support Reels
- Reels require exactly 1 video
- Stories do not support captions

**Reference:** Platform Limitations Guide

type.description:
Facebook post format type.

**Available Types:**
- `post` - Standard feed post (images, videos, text)
- `story` - 24-hour temporary story
- `reel` - Short-form vertical video

**Restrictions:**
- Reels: Require exactly 1 video, not supported on Groups
- Stories: Captions not supported

textFormatPresetId.description:
Facebook background preset ID for text-only feed posts. **Facebook `post` only** — not `story` or `reel`. Ignored when media is attached; `metaLink` is omitted on publish.

**Validations** — request returns `400` if violated:
- Must be a valid preset ID from the Facebook text background preset reference. Empty strings, whitespace-only values, and `null` are rejected.
- When set, `summary` must be 130 characters or fewer.

instagramPostDetails.description:
Instagram-specific post configuration.

**Key Fields:**
- `type`: Post type (`post`, `story`, `reel`)
- `collaborators`: Map of account IDs to Instagram usernames for collaboration invites (max 5 per account)
- `showOnFeed`: Show reel on profile feed (for reels)

**Collaborators Structure:**
```json
{ "accountId": ["username1", "username2"] }
```
Where `accountId` is from [Get Accounts API](/social-media-posting/oauth/{locationId}/accounts) and usernames are Instagram handles without @.

**Restrictions:**
- Media is REQUIRED for all Instagram posts
- Max 30 hashtags allowed in caption
- Stories do not support captions
- Collaborators: Posts/Reels only (NOT Stories)
- Reels require exactly 1 video

**Reference:** Platform Limitations Guide

type.description:
Instagram post format type.

**Available Types:**
- `post` - Standard feed post (images, videos, carousels)
- `story` - 24-hour temporary story
- `reel` - Short-form vertical video (up to 90 seconds)

**Restrictions:**
- Media is REQUIRED for all Instagram posts
- Reels: Require exactly 1 video
- Stories: Captions not supported, JPEG only for images

collaborators.description:
Collaboration invites mapping account IDs to Instagram usernames.

**Structure:** `{ accountId: [username1, username2, username3] }`

- **Key:** Account ID from `accountIds` array (the Instagram account posting)
- **Value:** Array of Instagram usernames to invite as collaborators

**Get Account IDs from:** [Get Accounts API](/social-media-posting/oauth/{locationId}/accounts) — use the `id` field from Instagram accounts.

**✅ Supported for:** Posts and Reels only (NOT Stories)

**Validations:**
- Maximum 5 collaborators per account
- No duplicate usernames allowed
- Usernames are Instagram handles without @

**Use Case:** Invite other Instagram users to collaborate. Once accepted, the post appears on both profiles.

publishViaPushNotification.description: Send Instagram Story via Push  Notification instead of direct posting. Only applicable for Story type.

publisherNote.description: Note to the publisher for manual posting guidance. Only used when publishViaPushNotification is true.
publisherNote.example: When publishing, add swipe up link to the landing page so that we can direct them to the sales page

notificationSentCount.description: Number of push notifications sent for this Instagram Story. Tracks how many notifications have been sent out.

postedVia.description: Source of where the post was marked as published. Values: "web" (web interface), "mobile" (mobile app), or null.

showOnFeed.description:
Show Reel on profile grid/feed.

**✅ Applies to:** Reels only

- `true` - Reel appears on your profile grid
- `false` - Reel only appears in Reels tab

youtubePostDetails.description:
YouTube-specific post configuration.

**Key Fields:**
- `title`: Video title (max 100 characters)
- `type`: Video type (`video` for regular videos, `short` for YouTube Shorts)
- `privacyLevel`: Video visibility (`private`, `public`, `unlisted`)

**Limits:**
- Max 1 video per post
- Caption (description) max 5,000 characters

**Requirements:**
- Video is REQUIRED for YouTube posts
- `type` field is required

title.description:
Video title displayed on YouTube.

**Max length:** 100 characters

**Best Practices:**
- Include relevant keywords
- Be descriptive but concise
- Avoid clickbait
title.example: How to Build a Successful Marketing Strategy in 2024

privacyLevel.description:
Video visibility/privacy setting.

**Available Values:**
- `public` - Anyone can search and view
- `unlisted` - Only people with the link can view
- `private` - Only you can view

type.description:
YouTube video format type.

**Available Types:**
- `video` - Standard YouTube video (landscape, any duration)
- `short` - YouTube Shorts (square or vertical aspect ratio, up to 3 minutes)

**Required field.**

communityPostDetails.description:
Community-specific post configuration for Communities.

**Required Fields:**
- `title`: Post title (max 1,000 characters)
- `postAsUser`: the member to publish as, keyed by Community account ID

**Optional Fields:**
- `notifyAllGroupMembers`: notify all group members (`@everyone` broadcast)

**Limits:**
- Max 4 media items
- Caption max 100,000 characters

**Required when** `accountIds` contains a Community account and the post is not a draft.

title.description:
Title of the community post. Displayed as the post headline.

**Max length:** 1,000 characters

**Required:** Yes, for all Community posts.

notifyAllGroupMembers.description:
Notify every member of the group when the post is published, equivalent to an `@everyone` broadcast prepended to the post content.

**Use Case:** Enable for announcements that all members should see.

**Default:** `false`

postAsUser.description:

id.description:
Step ID. Any non-empty string, unique within the definition — a readable id like `welcome-sms` is fine, and `edges` reference it by that name. It does not have to be a UUID; ids that are not get converted to one when the workflow is saved, so a definition read back will carry the converted ids rather than the ones sent.

**Reuse ids across updates.** A step keeps contacts already mid-workflow on their current step only while it keeps its id. Sending back the ids from Get Workflow Definition is the reliable way to do that — a readable id also converts to the same value every time for a given workflow, so re-sending an authored definition is safe too.

version.description:
The workflow's version counter, owned by the system — not a format version. Get Workflow Definition fills it in; leave it untouched and send it back on update, and a concurrent edit in the builder can never be silently overwritten. A stale value is rejected with 422.

Treat it as opaque: echo it, never compute from it. It does not always advance by one (delete and restore each add 0.1, and a later save rounds up), so it is not always an integer.

Optional here: a create-shaped definition has no counter yet.
